data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of the 2016 Ogden margin which drove an improvement on the Liability class

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: Net losses totalling $22,359k (GBP 16,546k) (after reinsurance) from these Q3 catastrophe losses which also accelerated reinsurance earning patterns
Net losses of $8,248k (GBP 6,104k) incurred at the year end

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 353.514m. Using the gross claims development triangle, prior-year development on underwriting years up to 2015 produced a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 21.0m (5.9% of opening gross reserves). The deterioration was largely driven by catastrophe losses (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexico earthquakes and Californian wildfires), adverse attritional development and large loss activity on the Property, Marine and Special Lines portfolios, partially offset by releases in certain older years and an Ogden-related release on Liability.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.
Large loss activity on the Marine and Special Lines classes, and adverse attritional loss development on the Property and Marine lines further deteriorated the results.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Lines of business no longer written

data.data_quality_notes: The report's narrative (note 7) quotes a net prior-year deterioration (GBP 11,547k) but does not state an aggregate GROSS prior year movement. Accordingly the prior_year_development_gbp_m was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 20). This triangle-based total is an aggregate across individual underwriting years (2011-2015) and is therefore a fallback calculation; confidence set to 0.8. No Reinsurance-to-Close distortion was identified. All monetary amounts in the triangle are presented in GBP '000 in the source and have been converted to millions in this output.
